quotes: The Bachelor of Science is a three-year program designed for students with a strong interest in Mathematics and Science. This highly selective and multidisciplinary program is taught entirely in English.
Three Years - 180 ECTS Three Double Majors September International In France In English
students work towards one of three double majors: Mathematics and Physics Mathematics and Computer Science Mathematics and Economics

faq.title: Bachelor FAQ - École Polytechnique
quotes: However, as with all of École Polytechnique’s academic programs, the Bachelor programs are designed for top students with very high potential and we require them to have a strong overall academic average.
For the moment, there are no minimum grades required to be able to apply for the programs.
Annual tuition fees for 2027 intake are €15,900 for EU (including EEA) students and €19,600 for non-EU (non-EEA) students.
Accommodation currently costs €606 per month (2026 intake, amount revised annually in January) and is not included in the tuition fees.
International Baccalaureate: Mathematics Higher Level (preferably “Analysis and Approaches”) and at least one other science course should be Higher Level.
A-level program: Mathematics and at least one other scientific subject should be Higher Level.
The minimum grades required are: - TOEFL iBT : 90 - IELTS : 6,5 (minimum grade per each language skill: 6)

program.name: Bachelor of Science (double major: Mathematics with Physics, Computer Science or Economics)
program.summary: Bachelor of Science, École Polytechnique (Palaiseau); three years, 180 ECTS, taught entirely in English, leading to a double major in Mathematics and Physics, Computer Science or Economics.

costs.note: Non-EU (non-EEA) students: €19,600 a year (2027 intake). On-campus accommodation is extra: €606 per month (2026 intake).
EU (including EEA) students: €15,900 a year (2027 intake).

admissions.threshold: Bachelor of Science: IB with Mathematics at Higher Level (preferably Analysis and Approaches) and at least one other science at Higher Level. There are no minimum grades; the programme is highly selective and expects a strong overall academic average.

english.min_score: TOEFL iBT 90; IELTS 6,5 as published (at least 6 in each skill).

admissions.threshold: Bachelor of Science: A levels including Mathematics and at least one other scientific subject. There are no minimum grades; the programme is highly selective and expects a strong overall academic average.

english.min_score: TOEFL iBT 90; IELTS 6,5 as published (at least 6 in each skill).
